issue.title: library: a skill set aside across disks or with a stuck file is left half-emptied, and the error doesn't say where the whole copy went
issue.body:
Found while adding batch remove for "In your agents" skills (2d721f7f3). This affects single remove too.

`setAside` (internal/library/skills.go) moves an agent's skill folder into the backups through `move`. When `os.Rename` fails (another disk, or a folder that can't be renamed), `move` copies the folder into the backup and then runs `os.RemoveAll` on the original. If the removal stops partway, for example with a read-only parent or a file held open on Windows, `move` returns `leftBehind`:

- The skill's folder is left half-emptied. Some files are gone and the rest stay.
- `setAside` returns `""` along with the error, so the remove fails without saying that a whole copy is in the backups, or where.
- In a sandbox with a read-only parent folder, the skill's files were emptied while the remove reported a failure.

What the user sees is a skill that lost files and an error. Nothing tells them the files are safe in `~/.magpie/backups/<stamp>/...`.

Fix: on `leftBehind`, return the backup path, and either put back the files that were removed or say "removed partly, the whole copy is at <path>". Add a test where the original is read-only partway through.

comments.body:
Fixed on a fork branch: `fix/1903-setaside-leftbehind` (head `76dc5c2e`, on upstream `6eb510f7`) — a skill left half-emptied on a stuck set-aside says where the whole copy is.

**Root cause.** `internal/library/skills.go`'s `move` returns `&leftBehind` when the backup copy succeeded but `os.RemoveAll` stopped partway; `setAside` then returned `("", err)`, so the remove failed without saying that a whole copy was safe in `~/.magpie/backups/…`.

**Change.** `setAside` returns the backup path and an error that names it ("removed partly, the whole copy is at <path>") when the move came back `leftBehind`; the five callers all ignore the path on error, so nothing else changes. Putting the removed files back is a separate design and is not attempted here.

**Verified.** Red: `go test -tags nogui ./internal/library/ -run TestSetAsideLeftBehindSaysWhereTheCopyIs` → `setaside_leftbehind_test.go:46: no path named for where the whole copy went`
Green: `same command → `ok`; the whole `./internal/library/` package passes` → `ok github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/library`

The test makes a skill folder whose subdirectory cannot be unlinked (mode 0555), so `RemoveAll` stops partway after the copy; it is skipped when the tests run as root or when the temp dir and its fallback share a filesystem (no EXDEV to force the copy path).

Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` over round 27's branches: 70 packages ok, 5 red (edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`, gateway's five, plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, provider's synctest fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`, testenv `TestProgram`) — every one of them reproduces identically at base `6eb510f7` in this environment (umask 0027), so none is from this change.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/1903-setaside-leftbehind — no PR opened, this repo takes no external PRs; say the word if you'd rather have the patch inline here.
